sources: https://www.camplife.com/388/reservation/step1 (CampLife booking API: reservation session and site records for campground 388, read 2026-10-21)

values.note: Storm closure: 'Notice of Temporary Closure. This recreation site is temporarily closed because of potential storm-related impacts.' (posted during Hurricane Isaias, October 2026). No reopening date posted; the District's Recreation Site Closures page does not list this site.

status.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/chipola-river/christoff-landing/ ('Notice of Temporary Closure. This recreation site is temporarily closed because of potential storm-related impacts.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Free permit booked through the District's CampLife reservation system (a free account is needed, and availability shows only once logged in). Up to 7 nights per reservation; no more than two reservations at a time or in a 30-day period.

booking.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/chipola-river/christoff-landing/ ('three overnight campsites ... by reservation only', 'Reserve A Site' link to camplife.com/388) + https://nwfwater.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Step-by-Step-Instructions-on-How-to-Make-A-Camping-Reservation.pdf ('A reservation can be made for up to seven (7) nights. No more than two (2) reservations can be booked at a time or in a 30 day period'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: CampLife site records for campground 388 (Sites 1-3: 'No Hookup. RV and Tent sites with fire rings, a grill, and a pavilion.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Three back-in sites taking motorhomes, fifth wheels, truck campers, vans, fold-downs and tents. CampLife lists every site as 50 x 50 ft, which looks like a default rather than a measured length, so no max rig length is recorded.

sites.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/chipola-river/christoff-landing/ ('This area offers three overnight campsites') + CampLife session for campground 388 (site type 'Back In', equipment MOTORHOME, 5TH WHEEL, TRUCK CAMPER, VAN, FOLDDOWN, TENT), read 2026-10-21

note: Northwest Florida Water Management District campground on the Chipola River near Marianna (Bumpnose Rd). Wooded sites about 150 yards down the access road (Christoff Ferry Landing Road) to the west of the boat ramp; RVs allowed. Pavilion, fire rings, grills and one portable toilet. Site length is not published - primitive sites on unpaved access; check the site diagram before bringing a big rig. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the District page and its CampLife booking records: 3 reservation-only back-in sites taking motorhomes, no hookups, 7-night limit, free. Added a temporary storm closure (banner on the site page, October 2026). Note trimmed of the count/hookup/booking facts the fields carry. Not stated: a real max rig length (CampLife's 50 ft on every site looks like a default), season, potable water.
flags: Temporary storm closure recorded from the District's site-page banner ('temporarily closed because of potential storm-related impacts', Hurricane Isaias, October 2026); the District's own Recreation Site Closures list does not include Christoff Landing, so the two pages disagree. Needs a re-check soon.
Availability on CampLife is shown only to a logged-in (free) account ('To see availability for this date range, please log in above.'); camping is free, so no rate is hidden.
